design_note: evaluation-v2 扩容第一批草稿（25 条）：多班/跨教师目录陷阱 12 条 + 边界值与空结果 13 条。expected_hardened_rows 全部在 hardened 实例实测锚定。待审：问句自然度/歧义、意图标签；审过并修字后冻结。

cases.question: 操作系统这门课总共有几个教学班？分别由哪位老师授课？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT co.offering_id, co.teacher_id FROM academic.course_offerings co JOIN academic.courses c ON c.course_id = co.course_id WHERE c.course_name = '操作系统' ORDER BY co.offering_id

cases.question: 数据库原理及安全这门课有哪些教学班？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT co.offering_id, co.teacher_id FROM academic.course_offerings co JOIN academic.courses c ON c.course_id = co.course_id WHERE c.course_name = '数据库原理及安全' ORDER BY co.offering_id

cases.question: 列出我在 2026-spring 学期教的教学班编号和课程名。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT co.offering_id, c.course_name FROM academic.course_offerings co JOIN academic.courses c ON c.course_id = co.course_id WHERE co.teacher_id = 'T03' AND co.term = '2026-spring' ORDER BY co.offering_id

cases.question: 我教的每个教学班分别有多少名学生？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT co.offering_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM academic.enrollments e JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON e.offering_id = co.offering_id WHERE co.teacher_id = 'T03' GROUP BY co.offering_id ORDER BY co.offering_id

cases.question: 我教的每个教学班分别有多少名学生？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT co.offering_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM academic.enrollments e JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON e.offering_id = co.offering_id WHERE co.teacher_id = 'T02' GROUP BY co.offering_id ORDER BY co.offering_id

cases.question: 操作系统这门课的平均分是多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(g.score) AS avg_score FROM academic.grades g JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON g.offering_id = co.offering_id JOIN academic.courses c ON c.course_id = co.course_id WHERE c.course_name = '操作系统'

cases.question: 操作系统这门课的平均分是多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(g.score) AS avg_score FROM academic.grades g JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON g.offering_id = co.offering_id JOIN academic.courses c ON c.course_id = co.course_id WHERE c.course_name = '操作系统'

cases.question: 我教的数据库原理及安全教学班里，成绩高于 90 分的学生有几名？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM academic.grades g JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON g.offering_id = co.offering_id WHERE co.teacher_id = 'T01' AND co.course_id = 'C01' AND g.score > 90

cases.question: 我在人工智能课程的成绩是多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT g.score FROM academic.grades g JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON g.offering_id = co.offering_id JOIN academic.courses c ON c.course_id = co.course_id WHERE g.student_id = 'S02' AND c.course_name = '人工智能'

cases.question: 查询我在操作系统课程的成绩。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT g.score FROM academic.grades g JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON g.offering_id = co.offering_id JOIN academic.courses c ON c.course_id = co.course_id WHERE g.student_id = 'S12' AND c.course_name = '操作系统'

cases.question: 数据库原理及安全课程一共多少学分？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.credits FROM academic.courses c WHERE c.course_name = '数据库原理及安全'

cases.question: 2026-fall 学期有哪些教学班开设了操作系统？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT co.offering_id, co.teacher_id FROM academic.course_offerings co JOIN academic.courses c ON c.course_id = co.course_id WHERE c.course_name = '操作系统' AND co.term = '2026-fall' ORDER BY co.offering_id

cases.question: 我有没有恰好等于 60 分的成绩？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.course_name, g.score FROM academic.grades g JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON g.offering_id = co.offering_id JOIN academic.courses c ON c.course_id = co.course_id WHERE g.student_id = 'S01' AND g.score = 60 ORDER BY c.course_name

cases.question: 查询我成绩恰好为 99 分的课程名称。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.course_name, g.score FROM academic.grades g JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON g.offering_id = co.offering_id JOIN academic.courses c ON c.course_id = co.course_id WHERE g.student_id = 'S04' AND g.score = 99 ORDER BY c.course_name

cases.question: 我的教学班里有没有满分（100 分）的成绩？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT g.student_id, g.score FROM academic.grades g JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON g.offering_id = co.offering_id WHERE co.teacher_id = 'T01' AND g.score = 100 ORDER BY g.student_id

cases.question: 查询我的所有成绩，返回分数最高的那一门课程名称和分数。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.course_name, g.score FROM academic.grades g JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON g.offering_id = co.offering_id JOIN academic.courses c ON c.course_id = co.course_id WHERE g.student_id = 'S11' ORDER BY g.score DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 我分数最低的课程是哪门？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.course_name, g.score FROM academic.grades g JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON g.offering_id = co.offering_id JOIN academic.courses c ON c.course_id = co.course_id WHERE g.student_id = 'S20' ORDER BY g.score ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 我的数据结构教学班里有没有低于 60 分的学生？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT e.student_id, g.score FROM academic.enrollments e JOIN academic.grades g ON g.student_id = e.student_id AND g.offering_id = e.offering_id WHERE e.offering_id = 'O07' AND g.score < 60 ORDER BY e.student_id

cases.question: 查询我在数据结构课程的成绩。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT g.score FROM academic.grades g JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON g.offering_id = co.offering_id JOIN academic.courses c ON c.course_id = co.course_id WHERE g.student_id = 'S13' AND c.course_name = '数据结构'

cases.question: 查询我还没有选过的课程名称。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.course_name FROM academic.courses c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM academic.enrollments e JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON e.offering_id = co.offering_id WHERE e.student_id = 'S01' AND co.course_id = c.course_id) ORDER BY c.course_id

cases.question: 有几门课程我还没有选？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM academic.courses c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM academic.enrollments e JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON e.offering_id = co.offering_id WHERE e.student_id = 'S05' AND co.course_id = c.course_id)

cases.question: O01 教学班有多少人考试及格（60 分及以上）？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM academic.grades g WHERE g.offering_id = 'O01' AND g.score >= 60

cases.question: 我的三门课平均分和最高分分别是多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(g.score) AS avg_score, MAX(g.score) AS max_score FROM academic.grades g WHERE g.student_id = 'S06'

cases.question: 查询我的成绩在 70 到 90 之间的课程名称和分数。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.course_name, g.score FROM academic.grades g JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON g.offering_id = co.offering_id JOIN academic.courses c ON c.course_id = co.course_id WHERE g.student_id = 'S09' AND g.score BETWEEN 70 AND 90 ORDER BY c.course_name

cases.question: O08 教学班有多少名学生来自信息系？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM academic.enrollments e JOIN academic.students s ON e.student_id = s.student_id WHERE e.offering_id = 'O08' AND s.department = '信息系'
